result.instructions: Tools for Brightpearl, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales orders were placed yesterday and are still waiting to be shipped?"; "How much stock of SKU ABC-123 do we have in each warehouse?"; "Show the full details and notes of order 100182.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Brightpearl data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run brightpearl_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run brightpearl_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run brightpearl_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. brightpearl_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_account_configuration
tools.title: Get account configuration
tools.description: The Brightpearl account's configuration as key/value pairs: base currency, tax scheme, time zone, default and new-order status ids, nominal codes, weight unit, whether multiple warehouses are enabled. GET /integration-service/account-configuration.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search sales orders, sales credits, purchase orders and purchase credits. Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has orderId, orderTypeId, contactId, orderStatusId, orderStockStatusId, createdOn, updatedOn, customerRef, externalRef, warehouseId and more. Use brightpearl_get_orders for the full order. Order type ids: brightpearl_list_order_types; status ids: brightpearl_list_order_statuses. GET /order-service/order-search.

order_ids.description: Only these orders (one or more ids).

order_type_id.description: Order type id (1 sales order, 2 purchase order, 3 sales credit, 4 purchase credit; see brightpearl_list_order_types).

contact_id.description: Only orders of this customer/supplier contact id.

external_ref.description: External reference of the order (for example the web shop's order number).

id_or_external_ref.description: Matches an order id OR an external reference (case-insensitive match).

warehouse_id.description: Only orders for these warehouses (one or more ids).

created_from.description: Created: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

created_to.description: Created: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_from.description: Last updated: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_to.description: Last updated: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

placed_from.description: Placed: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

placed_to.description: Placed: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

newest_first.description: Newest (highest id) first. Default: oldest first.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_orders
tools.title: Get orders
tools.description: Full details of one or more orders by id: type, status, payment/stock/shipping status, dates, currency, totals, assignment, customer/supplier, billing and delivery parties, and the order rows (product, quantity, price, tax). Up to 50 ids. GET /order-service/order/{ids}.

include_custom_fields.description: Also return the order's custom field values (includeOptional=customFields,nullCustomFields).

tools.name: brightpearl_get_order_notes
tools.title: Get order notes
tools.description: All notes on one order (text, author contact id, date, whether it is public on the customer portal, the order status at the time). GET /order-service/order/{id}/note.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: The account's order statuses (id, name, order type code SO/PO/SC/PC, sort order, disabled, visible to the customer, state such as draft). Use the ids to filter orders or to change an order's status. GET /order-service/order-status.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_order_types
tools.title: List order types
tools.description: The four order types with their ids and codes (1 SO sales order, 2 PO purchase order, 3 SC sales credit, 4 PC purchase credit), for the order search. GET /order-service/order-type.

tools.name: brightpearl_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an existing order. The note is private (staff only) unless is_public is true, which makes it visible on the customer portal. Returns the new note id. Notes cannot be removed with this server. POST /order-service/order/{id}/note.

is_public.description: Visible to the customer on the customer portal. Default false.

tools.name: brightpearl_update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: WRITE: move an existing order to another status (ids from brightpearl_list_order_statuses; the new status must exist, be visible and belong to this order's type). Brightpearl adds an order note on success, and status changes can trigger the account's alerts and automations. Moving a sales order to the account's 'cancelled' status removes its reservations and coupons and is refused while goods-out notes or payments exist. PUT /order-service/order/{id}/status.

note.description: Text of the order note Brightpearl adds (default: generated by Brightpearl).

note_is_public.description: Make that note visible on the customer portal. Default false.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue. Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has productId, productName, SKU, barcode, EAN, UPC, ISBN, MPN, stockTracked, createdOn, updatedOn, brightpearlCategoryCode, productGroupId, brandId, productTypeId, productStatus, primarySupplierId. Use brightpearl_get_products for full details. GET /product-service/product-search.

product_ids.description: Only these products (one or more ids).

brand_id.description: Only these brands (one or more ids).

product_type_id.description: Only these product types (one or more ids).

category_id.description: Only these Brightpearl categories (one or more ids).

product_group_id.description: Only products of this product group (variations); 0 = products that are not in a group.

product_status.description: Lifecycle status code, for example LIVE.

primary_supplier_id.description: Only products with these primary suppliers (one or more ids).

created_from.description: Created: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

created_to.description: Created: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_from.description: Last updated: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_to.description: Last updated: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

newest_first.description: Newest (highest id) first. Default: oldest first.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_products
tools.title: Get products
tools.description: Full details of one or more products by id: identity (SKU, barcodes), brand, type, stock-tracking, weight and dimensions, tax code, sales-channel names/descriptions/categories, bundle composition, variations, per-warehouse reorder levels, supplier and status. Up to 50 ids. GET /product-service/product/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_get_product_prices
tools.title: Get product prices
tools.description: Prices of products per price list: for each product and price list the currency, SKU and the quantity-break price map (e.g. {"1":"12","100":"11"}). Up to 50 product ids; optionally only some price lists (ids from brightpearl_list_price_lists). GET /product-service/product-price/{product ids}/price-list/{price list ids}.

price_list_ids.description: Only these price list ids (0 is the cost price list).

tools.name: brightpearl_get_product_availability
tools.title: Get product stock availability
tools.description: Stock availability of stock-tracked products: for each product the totals across all warehouses (inStock, onHand, allocated, inTransit) and the same per warehouse; optionally per location, with on-order quantities. Up to 50 product ids. GET /warehouse-service/product-availability/{ids}.

by_location.description: Also break the figures down by location within each warehouse.

on_order.description: Also include quantities on open purchase orders (total and shipped).

tools.name: brightpearl_list_price_lists
tools.title: List price lists
tools.description: The price lists (id, name, code, currency, SELL or BUY, gross or net). Id 0 is the cost price list. GET /product-service/price-list.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_brands
tools.title: Search brands
tools.description: Search product brands by name; each row has brandId, brandName, createdOn, updatedOn. GET /product-service/brand-search.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_categories
tools.title: Search product categories
tools.description: Search Brightpearl product categories; each row has id, name, parentId, active, createdOn, updatedOn. GET /product-service/brightpearl-category-search.

parent_id.description: Only the children of this category; 0 = the top-level categories.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: The warehouses (id, name, type, address id, click-and-collect settings, weekly operating hours). Use the ids for stock and order filters. GET /warehouse-service/warehouse.

tools.name: brightpearl_list_shipping_methods
tools.title: List shipping methods
tools.description: The shipping methods (id, name, code, carrier, price breaks, countries). GET /warehouse-service/shipping-method.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_goods_out_notes
tools.title: Search goods-out notes (shipments)
tools.description: Search goods-out notes, the pick/pack/ship records of sales orders; each row has goodsOutNoteId, printed, picked, packed, shipped, shippedOn, orderId, shippingMethodId, warehouseId, createdOn, releaseDate, transfer. GET /warehouse-service/goods-note/goods-out-search.

shipped.description: Only shipped (true) or not yet shipped (false) notes.

picked.description: Only picked (true) or not yet picked (false) notes.

packed.description: Only packed (true) or not yet packed (false) notes.

shipping_method_id.description: Only these shipping methods (one or more ids).

shipped_from.description: Shipped: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

shipped_to.description: Shipped: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

created_from.description: Created: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

created_to.description: Created: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

newest_first.description: Newest (highest id) first. Default: oldest first.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_goods_in_notes
tools.title: Search goods-in notes (stock received)
tools.description: Search goods-in records (stock received against purchase orders, by batch and location); each row has purchaseOrderId, batchId, productId, locationId, price, currCode, receivedQuantity, onHand, createdDate, receivedDate, warehouseId. GET /warehouse-service/goods-in-search.

purchase_order_id.description: Only stock received on this purchase order.

received_from.description: Received: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

received_to.description: Received: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

first_result.description: Position of the first row to return, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result for the next page.

newest_first.description: Newest batch (highest batch id) first. Default: oldest first.

tools.name: brightpearl_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts

Every filter is optional and they combine (AND); each result row has contactId, primaryEmail, firstName, lastName, companyName, isSupplier, isStaff, isCustomer, createdOn, updatedOn, lastOrderedOn and more. Use brightpearl_get_contacts for the full record. GET /contact-service/contact-search.

email.description: Matches any of the contact's email addresses (case-insensitive match).

phone.description: Matches any of the telephone or mobile numbers.

tag_ids.description: Only contacts with these tag ids (one or more ids).

company_ids.description: Only contacts of these company ids (one or more ids).

created_from.description: Created: on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

created_to.description: Created: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_to.description: Last updated: on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, whole day included) or ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

tools.description: Full records of one or more contacts by id: name, emails, phones, status, supplier/staff flags, financial details (price list, tax code, credit limit and terms), assignment, organisation, tags, dates; optionally custom fields and the full postal addresses. Up to 50 ids. GET /contact-service/contact/{ids}.

tools.name: brightpearl_add_contact_note

POST /contact-service/contact/{id}/note.

is_public.description: Visible to the customer on the customer portal. Default false.
